During an active current or proposed swing (phase 0..72), require explicit presence AND bears_support for every limb whose proposed phase is stance (>72). If any required support is missing, hold all four gait clocks and gate counters; continue semantic/sample time, joint/reference control, steering and the ordinary amplitude ramp. Once holding, release after three consecutive clear samples; interrupted clear dwell resets. At most 120 held commands, including the first two clear-dwell commands, are allowed. A further required hold safely refuses with unchanged memory; a third clear sample can release at the limit. Inactive or non-swing operation resets the guard. Preserve the parent's explicit evidence-limit mode transition. Use original contact observations without latching or inferring contact. Preserve V42 reference-geometry latches, full-reference versus wave-rate selection, measured floor geometry, servo gains, host signs and all speed/impulse caps at the selected phases. Record incoming/proposed/selected phases, exact contacts, missing support, counters and decisions in the native receipt. This changes gait progression, not the physical time budget, evaluator or recovery controller.
